$comment1: vcpkg manifest for the Windows GNS CI leg (#653). Only consulted when CMake runs under the vcpkg toolchain (CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=.../vcpkg.cmake) — local non-vcpkg builds ignore this file entirely. It exists to source protobuf on Windows, where there is no system package for GameNetworkingSockets to find.
$comment2: protobuf is pinned to 3.21.12 (the last pre-abseil 3.x line): GNS v1.6.0 does not build against the abseil-based protobuf 4.x/5.x that vcpkg HEAD ships. Port-version 4 carries the accumulated portfile fixes. Keep this pin in sync with the GNS version in cmake/dependencies.cmake.
